mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above the 5-year moving average coincides with a decline in 20-day S&P 500 forward returns due to higher discount rates eroding expected future cash flows.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above its 5mo moving average
failure_condition: Over a 60-day window, SPX 20d returns remain positive despite persistent FEDFUNDS above 5mo MA, or IC > 0.05 with t-statistic < -1.96.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in unemployment claims (PAYEMS) accompanied by a simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a labor market softening that precedes S&P 500 declines over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS crosses above its 4-week moving average while INDPRO falls below its 4-week moving average
failure_condition: Over 20 days, the joint signal recurs with positive SPX 5d returns and IC < 0.10.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) unexpectedly exceeds the Fed's target range by more than 0.5 percentage points, S&P 500 forward returns turn positive over the next 60 trading days as market anticipates rate cuts.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 3.0 and CPIAUCSL crosses above 3.5 within the same month
failure_condition: In a regime where FEDFUNDS remains unchanged for 3 months post-inflation spike, SPX 60d returns are not statistically different from baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained double-dip in manufacturing activity (INDPRO) below trend for two consecutive months predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days due to persistent supply-side constraints.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO remains below its 12mo moving average for two consecutive months
failure_condition: Over 60 days, INDPRO recovers above trend with SPX 20d returns positive and IC > 0.10.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in residential mortgage applications (HOUST) for three consecutive months indicates tightening credit conditions, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls for three consecutive months
failure_condition: Over 60 days, HOUST rebounds with no significant SPX 20d return deviation (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) without a corresponding drop in industrial production (INDPRO) suggests labor market weakness that precedes S&P 500 declines within 5 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS crosses above its 1mo moving average while INDPRO remains flat or declines
failure_condition: Over 20 days, similar labor signal recurs with positive SPX 5d returns and IC < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in retail sales (not available in provided proxies; fallback: use GDPC1 as a proxy for broad demand) coinciding with a decline in consumer confidence (not available; fallback: use UNRATE as a proxy for sentiment) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 crosses above its 12mo moving average while UNRATE falls below its 12mo moving average
failure_condition: In regimes with persistent high UNRATE (> 6%), the signal fails to predict positive returns (IC < 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in consumer spending (implied by a decline in GDP proxy GDPC1) followed by a rebound in industrial production (INDPRO) within the same month suggests cyclical supply absorption, associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls for two consecutive months then crosses above its prior month's value while INDPRO rises for two consecutive months
failure_condition: Over 60 days, the pattern recurs with negative SPX 20d returns and IC > 0.10.
